'''R2-C4''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]] that belonged to the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps|Space Fighter Corps]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo|Royal House]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]], often serving in the [[astromech socket]] of the [[N-1 starfighter]] [[Bravo Six|''Bravo 6'']].<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> This [[droid]] had been assigned to [[pilot]] [[Gavyn Sykes]].<ref name="KOTOBUKIYA">{{KotoCite|set=ARTFX+|pack=R2-C4|url=https://www.kotobukiya.co.jp/product/product-0000001554}}</ref> During the occupation of Naboo by the [[Trade Federation]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> R2-C4 was one of several Fighter Corps droids that was held in the [[Theed Hangar|hangar]] of the [[Theed Royal Palace]] in the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Theed]].<ref name="TPM" />

When [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo led the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in an [[Battle of Naboo|attempt]] to re-take the palace, the group attacked the Trade Federation's [[battle droid]]s stationed in the hangar, while the pilots of the Fighter Corps made their way to the s parked in the hangar so that they could take off and attack the Trade Federation's [[blockade]] of the planet. Once the security forces entered the hangar, R2-C4 and the other Fighter Corps droids began moving towards the [[starfighter]]s along with the pilots. Those that managed to reach their vehicles launched from the hangar and engaged the Trade Federation's [[blockade]] of the planet in orbit, ultimately helping to defeat the Federation and free Naboo.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-C4 first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The droid was first identified in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], in the form of an action figure released by Japanese toy company [[Kotobukiya]] in [[December]] [[2014]].<ref name="KOTOBUKIYA" />
